purpose: KC-A1 and its control KC-A1c of the three-dimension program (docs/readiness/2026-09-05-three-dimension-experiment-program.md section 4a). MF-1 (docs/readiness/2026-09-05-a2t-query-cue-audit-v1.md) closed with the KC-A1 gate PASSED: 235 of the sealed 4,000-row misses sit inside five disjoint TARGET tool sets whose queries separate at 0.86 to 1.00, so the cue exists in the speech and the registry's own descriptions do not carry it. On the owner's option B of 2026-09-06 this cell targets the LIGHTING cluster ALONE -- 8 tools, 147 of the 235 addressable rows -- the subset chosen because the five-target artifact rendered at roughly three times the program's then-binding +40-token form cap (the cap is advisory since the 2026-09-06 owner ruling, and this artifact measures +44); the other four targets keep their notes in configs/knowledge/a2t-kc-a1/targets-v1.json and are not flown here. KC-A1 appends a deterministic contrast note, derived from registry columns only, to the compact registry line of each of those 8 target tools; KC-A1c appends the registry's own category word alone, grown to exactly the same TOKEN count per line on the flight tokenizer. ORG-1 proved that a prompt-form change costs about 3 points on this carrier, so the pair is what separates content from form: KC-A1 minus baseline is content plus form, KC-A1c minus baseline is form, KC-A1 minus KC-A1c is content.
hypothesis: H1: a per-tool contrast note that names what separates a target's tools recovers part of the 147-row lighting mass MF-1 attributed to this cluster, and the recovered rows are concentrated on TARGET-pair misses. H2 (the control): the same number of added TOKENS carrying no contrast does not recover them. The lighting caveat MF-1 recorded stands beside H1 and is now the WHOLE population of the cell: all 147 of these rows are directions ORG-1 already halved without gaining a point, so a KC-A1 gain has to come from the contrast content surviving at a quarter of ORG-1's prompt cost.

predecessor.lesson: HARMFUL at -3.23 pp. The domain cue fired (cross-domain twin misses -16 %) and turned cross-domain misses into same-domain ones, and a form cost of roughly 3 points rode along with +87 text tokens and 465 lines against 155. KC-A1 keeps the 152-line shape byte-for-byte and pays a smaller, measured text cost; KC-A1c prices whatever remains of it.

artifacts.builder: scripts/build_a2t_contrast_notes.py --targets-spec configs/knowledge/a2t-kc-a1/targets-lighting-v1.json --tokenizer-url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --write (the tokenizer url is mandatory: --write refuses the retired chars-per-token estimator)
artifacts.form: Both arms render through the evolved-artifact-v1 fill: the same 152 lines, the same '- {signature}: {description}' shape, the same plain tool_name sort, no headers, ASCII only, every description under the 200-character cap (97 chars longest on KC-A1, 107 on KC-A1c). They are TOKEN-matched, not character-matched: each arm's whole rendered block measures 3,541 tokens against the compact block's 3,497 on the flight tokenizer, i.e. +44 each, and every one of the 8 changed lines costs the same number of added tokens in both arms. KC-A1 adds 161 characters and KC-A1c 213; the byte counts differ precisely because the token counts do not.
artifacts.form_cap_decision: CLOSED 2026-09-06 by owner ruling, after option B's estimate was falsified by measurement. Sequence: option B (LIGHTING only) was priced at an ESTIMATED +40 tokens; SAEA-A2T-KC-A1-CONTRAST-NOTES-PROMPT-FIT-V1 measured +44 on the pinned tokenizer and the character-matched control at +30, and the cell stopped; the owner then ruled that the +40 headroom is NOT a gate -- the invariant the program locks is the final score against a form-matched control, not a token count. The eight notes fly unaltered at +44 (no note dropped, none trimmed), the control is rebuilt TOKEN-matched, and SAEA-A2T-KC-A1-TOKEN-MATCH-V1 re-measured both arms at 3,625 system-message tokens each: +44 and +44, token symmetry exact. rails.proposer.validate_candidate_artifact is run with the server-backed counter and records 4 tokens of granted slack per arm rather than passing on an estimate. Program section 5 carries the ruling.
artifacts.flight_status: CLEARED FOR FLIGHT 2026-09-06 under the owner ruling. Both cells fly, sequentially, under this one experiment id: KC-A1-contrast-raw first, then KC-A1c-category-raw REGARDLESS of KC-A1's verdict, because the control is the attribution instrument and not a reward for an admitted treatment. The predecessor attempt (2026-09-06, run ids unregistered) stopped at the prompt fit on the form cap and flew nothing.

comparators.basis: the sealed official-protocol output of the SAME sample id under the SAME scorer, from the flight that drew that part of the union roster. Nothing is re-flown on the baseline side: greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch shapes on this runtime, so the sealed bytes are the only honest comparator. KC-A1c is additionally a comparator FOR KC-A1, paired row for row.
comparators.pooled_baseline: 61.40 % official tool accuracy over the 4,000 rows (68.11 % equal-domain), the number every KC-A1 delta is stated against.

paper_row.paper_column_note: reported beside every tier as the owner's reporting rule requires. It is a CEILING reference, not a gate: this run's decision is a paired delta against the sealed official-protocol cells and against KC-A1c, never a threshold relative to the published row. arXiv:2604.22821 Table 3 gives no Slot F1 for tier 1.

cells.factor: knowledge CONSTRUCTION: a deterministic contrast note, derived from the registry's own domain, category, argument names and constraints, appended inline to each of the 8 MF-1 LIGHTING target tools' description
cells.factor_a_output_contract: unchanged from R-official-raw and the three official-population cells: the published system-prompt sentence, the fixed '## Available Tools:' header, the same 152 registry rows in plain tool_name order, the same call-string output contract. ONLY the description column of 8 rows differs.
cells.user_turn: audio first, then the fixed sentence 'Convert this voice command to a tool call.'
cells.serving_geometry: -c 49152 -np 2, 24,576 tokens per slot -- the geometry the tier-1 and tiers-3/4/6/7 official-population cells and ORG-1 flew. The union carries four 654-second synthesis defects, so under the encoder's one-second window rule the worst row costs 8,515 speech tokens; the registry block grows by 161 characters (about 40 text tokens), which leaves the 8,192-token reserve intact with more margin than ORG-1 had. The prompt fit re-derives it before any generation.

cells.factor_a_output_contract: identical to KC-A1-contrast-raw, and token-matched to it line for line and whole-block on the flight tokenizer

cells.flies_unconditionally: YES, by the 2026-09-06 owner ruling, which withdraws the earlier 'KC-A1c flies only if KC-A1 is ADMITTED' clause. The control is what separates content from form and it is needed most when the treatment is null or harmful. It keeps its own run id and its own exposure row; it flies second, after KC-A1 is sealed and scored.

shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor, entered through scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py -- the same harness and entry point every Audio2Tool direct cell flew
shared_protocol.per_cell_dataset_fragment: each cell is launched with --dataset audio2tool-org1-union-4000; the runner composes model + dataset + baseline + experiment exactly as every earlier Audio2Tool direct cell did

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: PER CELL: 4,000 rows x 1 contact + 8 canaries = 4,008; the registered exposure ceiling per cell is 4,200. Two cells = two run ids = two exposure rows; core/model/adapter.py meters each plan cumulatively across every attempt of ITS OWN run id.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: PER CELL: 23,418.083083 s for one pass, rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires (23,419); the registered ceiling per cell is 24,600.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: PER CELL 0.75, registered ceiling 1.0. Basis: ORG-1 flew this exact roster and geometry in one pass; its plan carried 1.2 with a 2.0 ceiling and the sealed cells generate at 0.78 to 0.83 s per call at two slots, which projects about 2,900 s = 0.81 h. 0.75 planned with a 1.0 ceiling is the tightened figure the recovery plan asks for and still covers the observed rate.
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are each exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values, and the budget is cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

decision.primary: pooled official tool accuracy, KC-A1 minus the sealed official-protocol baseline, paired over 4,000 rows

three_outcomes.admitted: ADMITTED: the pooled CI90 lower bound is above 0, both weightings agree in sign, AND at least half of the corrected rows are TARGET-pair misses. The content clause below then says whether the gain is content or form.
three_outcomes.null: NULL: the CI90 includes 0, or the weightings disagree, or fewer than half of the corrected rows are TARGET-pair misses. The contrast-note content is not the lever at this form cost; program section 4a routes a NULL with separability >= 0.80 to EVO-A1 from the official baseline. KC-A1c still flies and still prices the form.
three_outcomes.harmful: HARMFUL: the CI90 upper bound is below 0. KC-A1 is dropped, and KC-A1c decides whether the harm was the contrast content or the 44 tokens of added prompt -- which is the question ORG-1 could not answer.

decision.control_clause: THREE-WAY DECOMPOSITION, fixed before takeoff (2026-09-06 owner ruling). Total effect = KC-A1 minus the sealed baseline; form effect = KC-A1c minus the sealed baseline; content effect = KC-A1 minus KC-A1c. Each is reported with CI90, saves/harms/ties, per tier with the paper column, per domain, under natural-mixture AND equal-domain weighting. KC-A1 is credited as a CONTENT effect only when the content contrast has a CI90 lower bound above 0; otherwise the movement is attributed to prompt form, which is a result about this frozen core's prompt sensitivity rather than about knowledge.
decision.baseline_is_unchanged_by_any_outcome: No outcome changes the direct baseline: the official-protocol cell stays the comparator every mechanism is paired against.
decision.gates_relative_to_the_published_ceiling: The paper column is reported beside every tier as a ceiling reference. No gate is set above it and none relative to it.
decision.claim_surface: Nothing here is a superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim; the population is discovery data already exposed on 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-05; no knob is tuned on it.
decision.not_authorized: No test contact, no fresh roster, no rollouts, no second contact, no retrieval, no change to the direct baseline, no Q8_0, no training-free policy fit, no edit to an artifact after its fragment was emitted. At most one recovery re-registration per run id.

why_two_run_ids: One estimand per run id and one exposure row per run id: KC-A1 and KC-A1c are two request sets over the same population, and contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's. Two run ids inside one experiment fragment is the shape SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-PROMPT-AB-V1 already flew, and it is what lets the control be skipped without touching the treatment's accounting.
